ai_positioning.summary: eBay actively integrates AI and machine learning into its operational strategies. The company uses AI to enhance user experience, automate listing processes, personalize search, and optimize business operations. Initiatives include AI-optimized listings, AI-assisted discovery tools, and live commerce capabilities.
